resources.string: Touch the screen as a touchscreen: taps and drags go where your finger is.

Drag to move the pointer. Tap to click. Long-press, or tap then drag, to hold the button (move windows, select text), two-finger tap for right click, three-finger tap for middle click, two-finger drag to scroll.
A connected mouse or touchpad always controls the pointer directly.
Shrink the desktop above the keyboard
Show extra keys above the keyboard (Esc, Ctrl, arrows…)
The desktop takes the size of this window: rotating the phone (or opening the keyboard, if enabled) resizes it, like plugging in a different monitor.
Text copied on the desktop can be pasted in Android apps, and the other way round. Android only lets Chameleon see its clipboard while Chameleon is open.
